gaps.lead: I would love to afford a bigger flat.
gaps.explanation: wish + subject + could = regret about ability/possibility.

gaps.lead: We got to the airport late and missed the flight.
gaps.sentence: If we had got to the airport earlier, we ___ the flight.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect, would(n't) have + participle.

gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: Action starting in the past and continuing: has been working (present perfect continuous).

gaps.lead: Everybody says he is the best dentist in town.
gaps.sentence: He ___ the best dentist in town.
gaps.explanation: be supposed to be = generally believed to be.

gaps.lead: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone about this.
gaps.explanation: keep something to yourself = not tell anyone.

gaps.lead: The mechanic is servicing my car tomorrow.
gaps.explanation: Arranged service: have/get something done — having my car serviced.
